QuestInfo.name: A Revenge on Gray the Alien
QuestInfo.0: I should go see Alien Gray.
QuestInfo.1: Whoa... Gray is taking an interest to this eraser... I mean, it's really nothing but a piece of rubber... okay, this is a good time to avenge the prank he pulled on me...
QuestInfo.2: I wound up trading a useless eraser for a very useful item.

0.0: Hello! How are you? Hmm... Haven't we met before?
0.1: Hey, I see something very intriguing with you... can you show me one? I'll just take a quick look at is give it back to you.

yes.0: Okay, so what's this called? An eraser? What are they used for...?
yes.1: It looks very interstng... and it resembles a creature we've been looking for... has this been frozen using special equipments?
yes.2: Anyway you and your eraser... are you willing to give me some? I just need one of each of the following: #b#t4001038#, #t4001039#, #t4001040#, #t4001041#, #t4001042#, and #t4001043##k.

no.0: Are you still wary of being around me because of that? Why don't we just forget about it and move on? No? Well, let me know when you change your mind.

1.0: Thank you. I can't believe you're giving me this important item. I need to pay you back for this. Tell you what, I'll give you #b#t01302049##k. This is a weapon made by us aliens.

yes.0: Again, thank you so much! Enjoy your weapon!

item.0: Are you sure you have the correct list of erasers from me? Please check it again.
